issue-4192: Export button stays greyed out after a failed export
Opened by ops-lukas on 2026-09-03

If an export fails (for example the server returns an error), the Export button
stays greyed out and I can't click it again until I reload the whole page.

args.title: Re-enable the export button after a failed export
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

In handleClick, exportReport(reportId, format).then(...) only resets busy to false in the success callback. If the returned promise rejects (as exportReport does via throw new Error(...) on a non-2xx response), setBusy(false) is never called and no .catch is attached, leaving the button permanently disabled until a full page reload.

Fix by also clearing the busy state on failure, e.g. by adding a .catch handler (or using try/finally with async/await) that calls setBusy(false) and shows an error toast, so a failed export leaves the button clickable again.
